knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Mapping and timing each step shows where enquiries are lost. More advertising or lower prices may not address the step that causes the loss.
A milestone or a stated satisfaction gives the client a reason to recommend the service. A first call or a mass message does not.
The Spam Act makes consent a condition for commercial electronic messages. Height and income are not relevant to consent.

practicalCriteria: Given a sample enquiry log, the learner maps the process and sets a time target for each step, and the assessor agrees the targets are measurable
The learner writes a specific referral request for one client milestone, without pressure or incentives that are not disclosed
The learner sorts a reactivation list into consent-recorded and consent-missing contacts, and only the first group is marked eligible for electronic messages
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sorted reactivation list with consent status
stopWorkCriteria: Stop any electronic reactivation message to an address without a consent record
Stop a pressure tactic on a lapsed client who has asked to stop
